verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an official MCP server that lets MCP-compatible agents such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor use it as a search tool, so users can drive it in natural language through an agent. A community thread confirms the MCP server is in real use, including Bearer auth on /mcp. The natural-language layer comes from the third-party agent, not from SerpApi itself, which remains a parameter-driven API. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface or command mode, documentation of which MCP tools are exposed and how natural-language requests map to them, and hands-on evidence of natural-language operation beyond auth setup.
